> historical context. The legacy `buddy.yml` and `release-buddy.yml` routes are
> retired. Do not use this document to recreate either route; current Buddy
> delivery is owned by Workflow Delivery v3.

This path remains a retirement interface for the
[v3 compatibility contract](../../../src/public/lib/three-workflow-delivery-v3/tests/contracts/test_commit11_legacy_buddy_retirement.py).

Use the [v3 handoff](../../../src/public/lib/three-workflow-delivery-v3/docs/agent-handoff.md)
and [legacy boundary evidence](../../../src/public/lib/three-workflow-delivery-v3/docs/research/legacy-workflow-boundary.md).
